name: isDefaultDenyApplicationControlEnabled
definition: Every current managed ThreatLocker computer enforces default-deny application control: Application Control in Secure Mode with no active maintenance mode. One computer short is a fail.
population: managed computers (not deleted, last check-in within 15 days of the newest check-in), all pages
evidenceRequiredForTrue: every judged computer in mode Secure with activeMaintenanceModes empty, from a complete read (distinct computerIds equal to totalRows)
